rules.name: create_id
rules.expr: ok and called("createStream") and (ret != pre("nextStreamId") or post("nextStreamId") != pre("nextStreamId") + 1)

rules.name: create_deposit_exact
rules.expr: ok and called("createStream") and (post("streams", ret, "deposit") != arg(1) * (arg(3) - arg(2)) or post("TokenC11.balanceOf", A0) != pre("TokenC11.balanceOf", A0) + arg(1) * (arg(3) - arg(2)))
rules.why: deposit equals rate*duration, fully escrowed (no truncation)

rules.name: create_fields
rules.expr: ok and called("createStream") and (post("streams", ret, "sender") != sender or post("streams", ret, "recipient") != arg(0) or post("streams", ret, "ratePerSecond") != arg(1) or post("streams", ret, "startTime") != arg(2) or post("streams", ret, "stopTime") != arg(3) or post("streams", ret, "withdrawn") != 0 or post("streams", ret, "cancelled") != 0)

rules.name: create_fresh
rules.expr: ok and called("createStream") and pre("streams", ret, "sender") != 0

params.forbidden: arg(0) == 0 or arg(0) == A0 or arg(1) == 0 or arg(2) < now or arg(3) <= arg(2)

rules.name: withdrawn_le_deposit
rules.expr: ok and (called("withdraw") or called("cancel")) and post("streams", arg(0), "withdrawn") > post("streams", arg(0), "deposit")
rules.why: never pay out more than deposited

rules.name: withdrawn_le_streamed
rules.expr: ok and called("withdraw") and (now <= pre("streams", arg(0), "startTime") or (now < pre("streams", arg(0), "stopTime") and post("streams", arg(0), "withdrawn") > (now - pre("streams", arg(0), "startTime")) * pre("streams", arg(0), "ratePerSecond")) or (now >= pre("streams", arg(0), "stopTime") and post("streams", arg(0), "withdrawn") > (pre("streams", arg(0), "stopTime") - pre("streams", arg(0), "startTime")) * pre("streams", arg(0), "ratePerSecond")))

params.forbidden: sender != pre("streams", arg(0), "recipient") or pre("streams", arg(0), "cancelled") != 0 or arg(1) == 0

rules.name: withdraw_exact
rules.expr: ok and called("withdraw") and (post("streams", arg(0), "withdrawn") != pre("streams", arg(0), "withdrawn") + arg(1) or post("TokenC11.balanceOf", A0) + arg(1) != pre("TokenC11.balanceOf", A0) or post("TokenC11.balanceOf", sender) != pre("TokenC11.balanceOf", sender) + arg(1))

params.forbidden: (sender != pre("streams", arg(0), "sender") and sender != pre("streams", arg(0), "recipient")) or pre("streams", arg(0), "cancelled") != 0

rules.name: cancel_marks
rules.expr: ok and called("cancel") and post("streams", arg(0), "cancelled") == 0

rules.name: cancel_releases_rest
rules.expr: ok and called("cancel") and post("TokenC11.balanceOf", A0) + pre("streams", arg(0), "deposit") != pre("TokenC11.balanceOf", A0) + pre("streams", arg(0), "withdrawn")
rules.why: cancel releases exactly the unpaid deposit

rules.name: cancel_recipient_owed
rules.expr: ok and called("cancel") and pre("streams", arg(0), "recipient") != pre("streams", arg(0), "sender") and now >= pre("streams", arg(0), "stopTime") and post("TokenC11.balanceOf", pre("streams", arg(0), "recipient")) + pre("streams", arg(0), "withdrawn") != pre("TokenC11.balanceOf", pre("streams", arg(0), "recipient")) + pre("streams", arg(0), "deposit")
rules.why: after stop, cancel pays recipient everything left

rules.name: cancel_before_start
rules.expr: ok and called("cancel") and pre("streams", arg(0), "recipient") != pre("streams", arg(0), "sender") and now <= pre("streams", arg(0), "startTime") and post("TokenC11.balanceOf", pre("streams", arg(0), "sender")) != pre("TokenC11.balanceOf", pre("streams", arg(0), "sender")) + pre("streams", arg(0), "deposit")

rules.name: cancelled_frozen
rules.expr: ok and (called("withdraw") or called("cancel")) and pre("streams", arg(0), "cancelled") != 0 and (post("streams", arg(0), "withdrawn") != pre("streams", arg(0), "withdrawn") or post("streams", arg(0), "cancelled") == 0)

rules.name: terms_immutable
rules.expr: ok and (called("withdraw") or called("cancel")) and pre("streams", arg(0), "sender") != 0 and (post("streams", arg(0), "deposit") != pre("streams", arg(0), "deposit") or post("streams", arg(0), "ratePerSecond") != pre("streams", arg(0), "ratePerSecond") or post("streams", arg(0), "startTime") != pre("streams", arg(0), "startTime") or post("streams", arg(0), "stopTime") != pre("streams", arg(0), "stopTime") or post("streams", arg(0), "sender") != pre("streams", arg(0), "sender") or post("streams", arg(0), "recipient") != pre("streams", arg(0), "recipient"))

rules.name: withdrawn_monotone
rules.expr: ok and (called("withdraw") or called("cancel")) and post("streams", arg(0), "withdrawn") < pre("streams", arg(0), "withdrawn")

rules.name: token_third_party
rules.expr: ok and (called("createStream") or called("withdraw") or called("cancel")) and u != sender and u != A0 and post("TokenC11.balanceOf", u) < pre("TokenC11.balanceOf", u)
rules.why: no one loses tokens in others' calls

rules.name: withdraw_pays_recipient_only
rules.expr: ok and called("withdraw") and u != sender and u != A0 and post("TokenC11.balanceOf", u) != pre("TokenC11.balanceOf", u)
